basis: Actual-source review by three independent Astra/xhigh scouts and a distinct Astra/xhigh preflight; no deployed-data exposure or pre-remediation runtime reproduction is claimed.
defect: V5 scans and deletes session copies before exact source/object generation proof; its session witness omits raw generation, a permanent same-job object receipt can mask a fresh successor SID, and rejected/accepted v5 extra plans share an ambiguous numeric cursor.
performance_budget: One strict KV read per frozen or compared session, one serialized object session-eligibility call before each v6 session delete, and existing bounded erasure checkpoints only. Serving paths gain no call. Capacity and latency remain unqualified.
rollback: Reviewed inverse only on the five pinned source/test files. V6 roots, session witnesses and tagged-v5 pages require a compatible reader or explicit reconciliation before older code runs.
limitations: Prospective DO-authorized eligibility and guarded exact snapshots only. Legacy concurrent KV writers/session-host authority, unseen SID reuse, legacy/grantless cleanup, migration/cutover/deployment, external/physical erasure, retention/capacity, customer/native/browser/SLO/release and full W35/F06/F14 remain open.
